title: Brazilian Tofu Curry
description: A vibrant and flavorful Brazilian-inspired curry made with tofu, energizing spices, and rich coconut milk.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: firm, drained, and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: energizing spice blend
ingredients.notes: or to taste (e.g., cayenne pepper, smoked paprika)

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the curry powder, energizing spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
